name: Governor's Palace (reconstruction)

dates.note: The completion year is the node's; Colonial Williamsburg's own journal records that on 5 December 1927 William Perry 'got authorization "to proceed with work on Wren Building" and reconstruction of the colonial Capitol and Governor's Palace' and that the Bodleian Plate, engraved about 1740 and showing the Palace, was found 21 December 1929 and arrived in Williamsburg in mid-January 1930. The dates of the original palace were not read from any fetched source and are not recorded.

note: Written 4 Sep 2026. A reconstruction, so no HABS survey (a loc.gov search found none) and no register entry of its own. It stands on two nodes with one record, as the schema intends: the colonial-revival node calls it the instrument of the accuracy phase and the georgian-revival node the reference library for the variant.
